design_parameters.enrich_notes: First flush WQ storage uses V=CPA with P=0.5 in; retention encouraged if fully evacuated within 36 h (Section 4-1.201). Primary preference is detention basins with positive outflow draining within 36 h; retention via basin-floor percolation is secondary (Rating 2) with same 36 h drain requirement and FCDMC double-ring infiltrometer testing. Full-storage facility drain times stated as generally 12–24 h (design guidance, not ED-specific). Parking-lot storage max water depth 6 in. Outflow invert typically 3 in above basin floor. Broader volume requirements referenced to SRC Chapter 37 (not in excerpt).
